notes: Visitors must show an onward/return ticket. Have the booking/ticket record on your phone.

notes: GOV.UK warns Barbados healthcare is costly and private clinics may want prepayment. Standby travel does not replace insurance.

why_critical: Phones need charging; must be 100-240V
notes: Check each charger says 100-240V.

why_critical: Lithium batteries allowed in cabin bag only (airline safety)
notes: Lithium batteries must go in cabin baggage, not hold luggage. Keep under 100Wh/ 27,000mAh.

notes: DO NOT bring UK 230V hair tools. Allure 503 lists a hair dryer. If you need straighteners, bring dual-voltage ones only.

item: Halal meat: DO NOT bring from UK
why_critical: Meat/poultry needs a permit; UK poultry banned; confiscated
notes: UK poultry cannot be imported and permits are needed for all meat, dairy and eggs (25 lb max). Buy locally. See 'Halal & groceries' notes below.

item: Halal chicken (Amir's Fresh Halal Chicken, local)
why_critical: Halal food needed and UK meat can't be brought
notes: Local halal-certified chicken (Fasons Foods) supplied to supermarkets. Phone 246-428-2647 to ask which supermarkets near Brighton Beach stock it.

item: Ghee / milk powder / cheese from UK
why_critical: Dairy needs a permit; confiscated if undeclared
notes: Dairy is an animal-origin product and needs a permit and approved-country rules. Leave at home.

notes: Listed by the Allure unit agents. For 503 the exact list of pans/knives/spice shelves is unconfirmed: CHECK WITH HOST.

item: Washing-up liquid, sponge, dishwasher tablets, bin bags
notes: Often only a small starter amount. CHECK, and buy locally on day 1.

item: Dried spices and masalas (sealed, commercial packs)
notes: Processed/dried spices in sealed commercial packs are normally ok. Declare any fresh, whole-seed or unprocessed plant products, as these must be inspected by Plant Quarantine. UNVERIFIED for spices; if in doubt, declare.
